other_information:
Been conferred several global honours and recognitions
1. King Abdulaziz Sash Award in 2016
Saudi Arabia`s highest civilian honour named after Abdulaziz Al Saud, the founder of the modern Saudi State. 
2. State Order of Ghazi Amir Amanullah Khan in 2016
Afghanistan`s highest civilian honour. 
3.Grand Collar of the State of Palestine in 2018
Palestine`s highest civilian honour for foreign dignitaries. 
4.Seoul Peace Prize Awarded in 2018 for `Modinomics` which reduced social and economic disparity between the rich and the poor. For the `Modi Doctrine` of foreign policy and the `Act East Policy`. 
5.United Nations` Champions of the Earth Award in 2018 for his bold environmental leadership on the global stage and vision of eliminating all single­ use plastics by 2022. For championing the International Solar Alliance, a global partnership to scale up solar energy. 
6.First-ever Philip Kotler Presidential Award in 2019 for his visionary leadership that has resulted in the Digital Revolution for making India one of the most lucrative manufacturing and business destinations in the world. 
7. Order of St. Andrew the Apostle, the highest order of the Russian Federation in 2019
The Order of St. Andrew the Apostle is both the highest and the oldest state decoration of Russia. For promoting partnership and friendly relations between the two countries. 
8. Zayed Medal from the UAE in 2019 in recognition of Prime Minister Modi`s pivotal role in strengthening ties between the two nations; The Zayed Medal is the highest decoration of the UAE awarded to Kings, Presidents and Heads of States
